meta.title: Avi Aggarwal, founder of hypjam | hypjam
meta.description: Avi Aggarwal is the founder of hypjam, a UGC agency in London that makes creator ads for startups and apps. His background and where to find him online.

hero.intro: Avi Aggarwal is the founder of hypjam, a UGC ad agency in London for startups and apps. He started it in August 2026.

paragraphs: Avi is a co-founder of Yummers, a food-identification app. In August 2026 he was a marketing intern at Cluely in New York, and from June to July 2026 he was a founding engineer at 8x.
He built dare-mcp-server, an open-source MCP server that is listed on the official MCP Registry. In March 2026 he was elected a Barnet Youth Ambassador.
